items.title: Gabriel India Limited partners with South Korea’s HL Klemove for Autonomous Driving including ADAS and Automotive Electronics as it accelerates its transformation into a diversified mobility solution conglomerate
items.excerpt: Pune, August 26, 2026: Gabriel India Limited (GIL), the NSE listed flagship company of the $2.2+ billion auto components manufacturer ANAND Group, has entered into a strategic joint venture with South Korea-based HL Klemove, under which Gabriel India will become a strategic shareholder in HL…
items.imageAlt: Gabriel India Limited partners with South Korea’s HL Klemove for Autonomous Driving including ADAS and Automotive Electronics as it accelerates its transformation into a diversified mobility solution conglomerate
items.body:
Pune, August 26, 2026: Gabriel India Limited (GIL), the NSE listed flagship company of the $2.2+ billion auto components manufacturer ANAND Group, has entered into a strategic joint venture with South Korea-based HL Klemove, under which Gabriel India will become a strategic shareholder in HL Klemove India Private Limited. The partnership marks a significant step in Gabriel India’s strategy to expand its presence across high-growth automotive segments and participate in the growing demand for Autonomous Driving Solutions including Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS), and Automotive Electronic Products through this joint venture. As India’s automotive industry advances toward smarter and safer mobility, Autonomous Driving and Automotive Electronics technologies are becoming increasingly important. HL Klemove is amongst a select group of companies globally with established development and manufacturing capabilities in autonomous driving technologies including ADAS and automotive electronic
technologies. With this joint venture company, Gabriel India will participate in this high-growth segment, enabling deeper engagement with automakers and broadening its presence in an evolving mobility landscape. Commenting on this, Mr. Jaisal Singh, Vice Chairman of ANAND who spearheads the group’s M&A, said, “As a key growth engine of the ANAND Group, Gabriel India is focused on building scale, enhancing competitiveness, and broadening its presence across high-growth automotive segments. Our latest joint venture with HL Klemove represents a strategic step forward in this endeavour.”

Mrs. Anjali Singh, Executive Chairperson of ANAND Group and Gabriel India Limited, said, “Bolstering our position across critical automotive systems while expanding our participation in future-oriented mobility and automotive technology segments, this new JV for Autonomous Driving and Automotive Electronics marks an important inflection point, enabling Gabriel India to further diversify its portfolio and strengthen its participation in emerging mobility segments.” Mr. Mahendra K Goyal, Group Chief Executive Officer of ANAND and Managing Director of Gabriel India Limited, said, “Beyond unlocking new opportunities for growth, this collaboration will foster
deeper OEM engagement, expand our participation in future mobility solutions and create enduring value for all stakeholders.”

To form the joint venture, Gabriel India Limited will acquire a 30 per cent less one share stake in HL Klemove India for US$98.44 million (approximately ₹935 crore). Gabriel India Limited will, through HL Klemove India, develop| manufacture| and sell| a range of advanced mobility solutions, including radar, front cameras, lidar, automated driving and parking control units, with embedded ADAS software, as well as automotive electronics products such as
brake ECUs, steering ECUs, chassis control units and torque sensors.

Building a Comprehensive Mobility Platform Over the last few years, Gabriel India Limited has been steadily diversifying its portfolio through strategic joint ventures in high-growth segments such as sunroofs, lubricants, EV fluids and precision fasteners. The partnership with HL Klemove builds on this momentum, broadening Gabriel India’s participation in the rapidly evolving Autonomous Driving and Automotive Electronics space through
HL Klemove India, while enhancing its competitive position and expanding its presence in a segment central to the future of mobility.

About ANAND Group:

Founded in 1961, ANAND is a US$2.2 billion+ (approximately ₹22,000 crore) conglomerate, highly acclaimed in the manufacture of world-class products and systems for the automotive industry. The group comprises 25 operating companies, including 15 joint ventures and 4 technical collaborations and has championed the idea of ‘Make in India’ since its inception 65 years ago. The group designs and manufactures technologically advanced products and solutions in ride control, motors, drive train, climate control, engine cooling, brake systems, sunroofs, sealants and adhesives, electric motors, safety products, and electric power steering, among others for India and the world.
The Group is spread over 87 locations across India and employs more than 22,000 people.

About Gabriel India:

Established in 1961, Gabriel India Limited is the flagship company of the ANAND Group and one of India’s most trusted names in automotive component manufacturing. With a legacy spanning over six decades, Gabriel has evolved as a market leader in ride control products, including shock
absorbers, struts, and front forks, serving every major automotive segment – two and three-wheelers, passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and railways.
With a footprint across 25 countries, including Belgium, the USA, Australia, the Netherlands, Latin America, and Africa, and trusted partnerships with leading OEMs, including those in the growing electric vehicle (EV) segment, Gabriel continues to be at the forefront of India’s mobility revolution.

About HL Klemove:

HL Klemove is a South Korea-headquartered autonomous driving and automotive electronics solutions company with end-to-end capabilities across perception, decision and control. Its portfolio spans advanced sensing technologies including radar and cameras, high-performance computing and
control units, ADAS software, as well as automotive electronic control products including braking and steering controllers. HL Klemove holds a leading position in Korea’s autonomous driving market and has a strong track record of pioneering ADAS technologies. With more than 2,700 patents and a
global manufacturing and R&D network across Korea, the United States, China, India and Mexico,

the company provides advanced mobility solutions to leading automotive OEMs globally. The company recorded approximately KRW 1.8 trillion in revenue in 2025. In India, HL Klemove India also holds a leading position in the autonomous driving sector and was the first company in the country to localize the production of both ADAS radar and smart cameras.

items.title: Press Release – Inalfa Gabriel Sunroof Systems plans to expand beyond Chennai to meet strong sunroof demand
items.excerpt: ∙ IGSS plans to expand with new facilities in Western and Northern auto hubs in India ∙ The planned expansion aims to support key customers Hyundai Motor India and Kia India while broadening IGSS’s customer base
items.imageAlt: Press Release – Inalfa Gabriel Sunroof Systems plans to expand beyond Chennai to meet strong sunroof demand
items.body:
Inalfa Gabriel Sunroof Systems plans to expand beyond Chennai to meet  strong sunroof demand 

∙ IGSS plans to expand with new facilities in Western and Northern auto hubs in India ∙ The planned expansion aims to support key customers Hyundai Motor India and Kia India  while broadening IGSS’s customer base

Chennai, Tamil Nadu, December 19, 2024: Inalfa Gabriel Sunroof Systems Private Limited (IGSS), a partnership between Inalfa Roof Systems and Gabriel India Limited, the listed flagship of the $2.2-billion ANAND Group, plans to set up new plants in India’s Western and Northern auto hubs to meet the rising demand for sunroofs.

The announcement was made this week by the ANAND Executive Chairperson, Mrs. Anjali Singh, at the first-year anniversary celebration of IGSS’s state-of-the-art facility on the outskirts of Chennai, which is reaching full capacity.

Speaking on the occasion, Mrs. Singh, said: “To meet the rising demand for sunroofs due to the greater premiumisation of the auto sector, IGSS is looking to expand beyond Chennai to other auto hubs, namely the West and North.
We plan to be closer to our valued anchor customers across the country and cater to their needs more efficiently via this planned expansion.”

Mr. Jagdish Kumar, Chairman, IGSS, and Group CFO, ANAND Group, said: “Our first facility in Chennai is nearly operating at its full capacity, delivering high-quality sunroofs to our respected anchor customers Hyundai Motor India and Kia India. Notably, the plant has produced 130,000 sunroofs in just the 11 months of 2024.”
The sunroof market in India is experiencing robust growth, driven by increasing customer demand for premiumisation and SUVs, as well as the growing trend of driving for holidays on a significantly improved highway network. IGSS initially chose Tamil Nadu for the state’s investor-friendly policies.
The growth in the sunroof segment is enabled by the rising popularity of panoramic sunroofs, which offer expansive views and a sense of openness. Technological advancements, such as smart glass technology and electrically operated systems, are also contributing to the market’s expansion.
Mr. Kumar, speaking on the occasion, added: “With the sunroof market set to expand by 40% by 2029, IGSS is well-positioned to capitalise on the growing demand. The plan for new plants shows the commitment we have to continue to be the leading player in the sunroof sector.”

Mr. Georges Andary, CEO, Inalfa Roof Systems, who was visiting the plant for the first-year celebrations, said: “We believe there can be no potential global growth strategy in the automotive business without India at its core. India is one of the largest, most dynamic, and fast-growing automotive markets in the world. Inalfa, in collaboration with Gabriel India, sees major potential for further growth in the sunroof segment.”

About IGSS
Inalfa Gabriel Sunroof Systems Private Limited is a collaboration between Gabriel India Limited, a flagship company of the ANAND Group, and Netherlands-based Inalfa Roof Systems, a global leader in sunroof technology. Operating its first plant near Chennai, Tamil Nadu, set up over a year ago, IGSS manufactures sunroof systems for India’s fast-growing passenger vehicle market, catering to leading OEMs.

About ANAND Group

ANAND is a $2.2-billion Group that has a legacy of over six decades, with over 20,000 employees and is a leader in manufacturing world-class products and systems for the automotive industry, with a focus on sustainable mobility. The Group has 24 companies, a number of them are JVs with 10 international partners, ranging from Europe to the US to Asia. It has also formed four technical collaborations. Complementing the Group is ANEVOLVE, a cleantech platform for mobility and beyond.

Gabriel India is the flagship of the ANAND Group. From being a single-product company in 1961, Gabriel India has transformed itself to become the most-trusted ride control products brand in India. Gabriel is also the leading manufacturer of shock absorbers for new generation vehicles in the 2 & 3-wheeler segment in India, including EVs.

About Inalfa Roof Systems

Inalfa Roof Systems is a global automotive roof systems manufacturer, based in Venray, The Netherlands, with factories and development centres in Europe, Northern America, and Asia. Inalfa delivers roof systems to almost every major car and truck manufacturer in the world. Inalfa Roof Systems is also an engineering-driven company, specialised in the design, development, and manufacturing of innovative solutions on a global scale, meeting the highest quality standards. At Inalfa, the top priority is ensuring a positive customer and end user experience. For more information, please visit.

items.title: Customer Sustainability Award to Dana Anand
items.excerpt: Dana Anand India (P) Ltd. (DAIPL) is recognized with prestigious “Sustainability Award” for outstanding contribution for year 23 under Mahindra Supplier Excellence Awards during annual Mahindra & Mahindra annual supplier meet in February 2024..
items.imageAlt: Customer Sustainability Award to Dana Anand
items.body:
Dana Anand India (P) Ltd. (DAIPL) is recognized with prestigious “Sustainability Award” for outstanding contribution for year 23 under Mahindra Supplier Excellence Awards during annual Mahindra & Mahindra annual supplier meet in February 2024..

Mahindra and Mahindra (M&M) is one of the key customers to Dana Anand India Pvt. Ltd. (DAIPL). M&M conducts annual supplier meet every year in which supplier representatives are participating.

DAIPL is driving various projects under Environmental Sustainability related to Energy and GHG, Water and Waste Management.

As a part of Dana’s sustainability targets, DAIPL’s major operations have solar roof top energy generation plants of 1.5 Mw capacity installed. Locations at Chakan and Jodalli are also using offsite generate solar energy. This has helped to offset the carbon emissions.
Apart from the energy and GHG, DAIPL has also implemented rainwater recharge projects at various locations.

This is one of the prestigious achievements for DAIPL as efforts of sustainability are recognized by esteemed customers like Mahindra and Mahindra.

In M&M’s annual supplier meet about 450 suppliers participated and DAIPL is awarded for sustainability among all suppliers.

The award was received by DAIPL Chairperson Mrs. Anjali Singh along with Mr. Mahendra Goyal – Managing Director and Mr. Kaushik Trivedi – Head Business Development – DAIPL

DAIPL will continue its journey on sustainability to contribute to achieve Dana’s sustainability targets of GHG reduction.

items.title: CII’s 5th next-gen e-mobility summit ’22
items.excerpt: EVs can disrupt the mobility ecosystem and redefine urbanization for good, ANAND's Executive Chairperson Anjali Singh said at CII's 5th next-gen e-mobility summit '22
items.imageAlt: CII’s 5th next-gen e-mobility summit ’22
items.body: EVs can disrupt the mobility ecosystem and redefine urbanization for good, ANAND’s Executive Chairperson Anjali Singh said at CII’s 5th next-gen e-mobility summit ’22 which she just chaired. Giving her welcome remarks, she told the delegates that e-mobility “possesses immense positive bearing on the global economy” but for India to really drive the transition successfully for future generations, “it needs a structured road map, with timelines, processes, well-researched impact studies, bold initiatives, and robust investments in technological research.” ANAND is already at the vanguard of the e-mobility transition working with leading OEMs and new clean mobility players.
